# Genes

Genes is an AI-readable specification for generating dependency-free PHP websites.

It helps coding LLMs create consistent projects with routing, localization, fixed
responsive layouts, JSON, SQLite, templates, assets and lightweight administration.

Specification: https://genes.one/genes.md
Repository: https://github.com/devrimvardar/genes
Documentation: https://genes.one/en/docs/
Examples: https://genes.one/en/examples/
Download: https://genes.one/en/download/
